payload.entry: LANDED (sase-1ph.land, 2026-10-28). VERIFIED all 5 phases on origin and reviewed each diff against the plan and decisions. core-contention: sase-core df14e8f4 matches the replayed patch (attempt_owed / one post-quarantine recreate / WAL attempt before deadline, plus RELEASE_BUDGET and three regressions). core_stress=reuse was honored, with no stress rerun. sase-1p6 is re-closed with core check 7263dbbc. flake-baseline: sase df0070b0aa. Owners verified, and the phase note's 'sase-1m' is a typo for sase-19m, which is what the file has. Gate rechecked at master 60a4fe8a92: exit 1 with the same 20 exceedances, no drift. nested-plans-validation: sase 60a4fe8a92 adds nested_repo_open_{checkout_root,sdd_root,plans_root,plans_remedy}, all used in non-test code (no whitelist), checks the nested checkout before SASE_SDD_PLANS_DIR, fails closed with a remedy, and leaves non-nested behavior unchanged. Every required regression is present, focused suites pass 34/34, and live validate_committed_plans passes for 5598 plans. heading-predicate: bob-cli 4005c613; the Lua grammar was checked by hand against all plan cases. rename-verifier: bob-cli 687375eb; split fixed too; the replaced CLI test matches the reference patch. INTEGRATION: post-start commits sase 528d5fe576/35b00c9dad, sase-core 0fd85e4a/95dc0c10, and bob-cli 38f15d3e/cba7c47d don't conflict. 0fd85e4a rewrote connection.rs busy handling but kept the sase-1p6 semantics. The sase core pin is now 95dc0c10, which contains df14e8f4. LANDING RECORDS: notes on sase-1ou (core + baseline commits; not closed), bob-cli-dg, bob-cli-d7, bob-cli-dc, bob-cli-dd, and bob-cli-e0 (full loss inventory; left open). tale_status=mark: status: done on bob-cli plans 202610/{d7_heading_prefix_closeout,backlog_b3_rename_closeout,finish_backlog_b4,b5_validation_closeout}.md via the opened external repo gh:bobs-org/bob-cli--plans; only the status lines changed. FOLLOW-UPS: one proposal (sase-1ph.3 #1, reconcile the athena scoped-check baseline). Declined as a new task because every node is owned. +1 sase-1ll for the 16 TERM-dumb rendering nodes. +1 sase-1p5 for the artifact-directory audit. +1 sase-1pg for scrub_agent_identity and the previously unowned test_start_monitor_kills_a_supervisor_that_never_writes_the_ack_marker, which share its root cause, found with a Popen probe: the tests patch global subprocess.Popen and capture an unrelated git subprocess whose env has SASE_AGENT; product scrub is correct. sase-19b/sase-1lp nodes did not fail in these runs; no action. epic-symbols: none.
